## Context / Problem
The summary-executor trio (`summary_route.py` 111 LOC, `adapters/jira/summary_operation.py` 244, `adapters/jira_datacenter/summary_executor.py` 263) is injected only by tests (`applier.py:603-608` passes no `summary_executor`); `payload_shadow.py` (161) is a test comparator; `apply()` still accepts raw dicts (`applier.py:437` `else m`) and `_mutation_to_batch_dict` keeps a two-shape heuristic (`batch_dispatch.py:136-138`); `_VALID_COMBINATIONS` (`mutation.py:37-42`) admits `(inbound, delete)` and `(inbound, probe)` while `typed_dispatch._build_leaves` (`:55-66`) registers no handler for either — both pairs are dead; `outbound_fields.py:246-675` is dead: the only production importer is `adapters/jira/backend.py:26,70` (`_map_local_to_jira_fields`), and `_extract_jira_field`, `_assignee_matches`, `_local_matches_prev`, `_jira_matches_prev`, `_parent_clear_is_managed`, `_resolve_reporter_account_id`, `_diff_reporter`, `_diff_fields`, `_INBOUND_MIRRORED_FIELDS` have zero production callers (re-homed in `outbound_field_diff.py`) while tests still exercise `_diff_fields`; `_concurrency.py` (35 LOC) is loaded by path by its sole importer; `acli_subprocess._MAX_BACKOFF_S` (`:148`) duplicates `_errors.MAX_BACKOFF_S` (`:29`); three `REBAR_RECONCILER_STATUS_GATING` comments linger. Cites are on origin/main 083620b0 (engine paths are under `src/rebar/reconciler/` after the package move).

## Approach
1. Delete the trio plus `BatchApplyContext.summary_executor` (`apply_handlers.py:102`), `_route_summary_via_executor` (`:429-448`), the branch at `:460-461`, `JiraBackend.execute_summary_operation` and `observe_summary_operation` (`adapters/jira/backend.py:321-343`), and `acli_rest.py:32-49` `_OneAttemptNoSleep`/`ONE_ATTEMPT_NO_SLEEP` + the `retry_policy` kwarg (`:63-93,229-254,359-371`; sole passer was `summary_operation.py:178`).
2. Delete `payload_shadow.py`, `tests/fixtures/reconciler/payload_corpus/`, `test_payload_shadow_*.py`; fix the `mutation_payloads.py:32,391` docstrings.
3. `applier.apply` batch form accepts `Sequence[Mutation]` only (`:437` → `_mutation_to_batch_dict(m)` unconditionally; a non-`MutationShape` element raises `TypeError`); `_mutation_to_batch_dict` reads typed payload attributes only (delete the raw-dict heuristic).
4. `_VALID_COMBINATIONS` becomes an explicit 10-pair frozenset; `typed_dispatch._build_leaves` asserts `set(handlers) == _VALID_COMBINATIONS`.
5. Delete `outbound_fields.py:246-675`; retarget `test_baseline_arbitration.py`, `test_diff_assignee_permissive.py`, `test_diff_assignee_unmappable_converges.py`, `tests/integration/test_reconcile_live_e2e.py:641,670,808` onto `outbound_field_diff.compute_update_fields` (delete cases with no live equivalent); the `.github/complexity-baseline.json` `_diff_fields` key becomes `stale` (not edited; a stale entry passes the ratchet).
6. Fold `_concurrency.snapshot_head` and `EMPTY_REPO_SENTINEL` into `applier.py` (delete `_load_concurrency` and `_concurrency.py`; update the `_ref_lock.py:22` and `src/rebar/_config_schema.py:665` comments). `acli_subprocess.py:148` → `from rebar.reconciler._errors import MAX_BACKOFF_S` (delete `_MAX_BACKOFF_S`). Delete the comment mentions at `apply_outbound.py:171`, `config.py:73` (engine config), `dispatch_apply_phases.py:72`.
7. `--filter-local-ids` (`request.py:94,112,123`) is kept: its sole consumer is the DC live harness (`tests/external/live_jira_dc/_dc_support.py:199-208`) and DC stays.
8. `docs/release-notes.md` gets an ADR 0107 "step 4 done" note (no ADR rewrite).

BREAKING: `applier.apply` batch form accepts typed `Mutation`s only.

## Scope
`src/rebar/reconciler/{summary_route,payload_shadow,_concurrency}.py` (deleted), `src/rebar/reconciler/adapters/jira/summary_operation.py` and `src/rebar/reconciler/adapters/jira_datacenter/summary_executor.py` (deleted), `src/rebar/reconciler/{apply_handlers,applier,batch_dispatch,mutation,typed_dispatch,apply_outbound,config,dispatch_apply_phases,_ref_lock,mutation_payloads}.py`, `src/rebar/reconciler/adapters/jira/{backend,acli_rest,acli_subprocess,outbound_fields}.py`, `src/rebar/_config_schema.py:665` (comment), `docs/release-notes.md`, `tests/fixtures/reconciler/payload_corpus/` (deleted), the tests named above. Out of scope: `docs/adr/0107` itself, `request.py` (`--filter-local-ids` kept), and retry behaviour (next story).

## Testing
Happy: `pytest tests/unit/reconciler -q`; `pytest tests/unit/reconciler/mutate/test_reconciler_coordinator_taxonomy.py -q`. Edge: `Mutation(inbound, delete, …)` raises `ValueError`; `applier.apply([{"action":"update"}], "p", root, client=fake)` raises `TypeError`; `git grep -n 'summary_executor\|ONE_ATTEMPT_NO_SLEEP\|payload_shadow\|_MAX_BACKOFF_S\|STATUS_GATING\|_load_concurrency' -- src` is empty; `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` reports the `_diff_fields` key under `stale`, `new=0`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Five modules deleted (`summary_route.py`, `summary_operation.py`, `summary_executor.py`, `payload_shadow.py`, `_concurrency.py`) — `git ls-tree`.
- [ ] `len(mutation._VALID_COMBINATIONS) == 10` and equals `set(typed_dispatch._LEAVES)` — unit test.
- [ ] `outbound_fields.py` ≤ 250 LOC exporting only `_map_local_to_jira_fields` + maps — `wc -l`, grep.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
